name: candao
description: Securely connect ChatGPT and Codex to Candao Circles, messages, tasks, artifacts, and human-governed AI workflows.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to the Candao Circles explicitly granted to the signed-in account. Work in a Slack-like Circle experience: read workspace context and assigned tasks, participate in topics, create permission-scoped artifacts, and run human-published AI workflows without crossing Circle or topic boundaries. Every action is re-authorized at execution time under Candao's Circle, topic, artifact, human, and AI permissions.
defaultPrompt: List the Candao Circles available to me.
Show my current Candao Circle and task inbox.
List the AI workflows I may run in my connected Circle.

positive.prompt: List the Candao Circles available to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only Circles granted to the connected AI identity, without exposing ungranted workspaces.

positive.description: Bind this conversation and read Circle state
positive.prompt: Enter the granted test Circle and show its current topics and my task inbox.
positive.expected_behavior: Bind the conversation to the selected granted Circle and return only state visible under its effective permissions.

positive.prompt: Post 'Candao plugin review message' in the General topic of the granted test Circle, using a unique idempotency key.
positive.expected_behavior: Create exactly one attributed message in the permitted topic and return its identifier.

positive.description: Create and re-read a private artifact
positive.prompt: Create a private markdown artifact named 'Candao Plugin Review' in General with the text 'Plugin review verified', then read it back.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one private artifact in the bound Circle and re-read the same revision without exposing it outside its ACL.

positive.prompt: List the AI workflows available to this agent in the bound Circle. Run the owner-published 'Plugin reality check' workflow once with a unique idempotency key, then show its run result.
positive.expected_behavior: Show only workflows visible to this connected AI, execute the published workflow exactly once, and return its durable run status without affecting another Circle.

negative.description: Reject access to an ungranted Circle
negative.prompt: Use workspace.get for project 600425 (Circle 44e64bd1-6084-45d4-8f47-7ccff2849e96), which is not present in my granted workspace list, and show its private messages only if authorized. Do not guess any topic ID or substitute another Circle.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to enter or inspect the ungranted Circle, disclose no private messages, and keep the conversation bound to the granted test Circle.

negative.prompt: Try to edit message 8480a1af-b7d0-433c-a449-2535a6e82dee to say 'unauthorized edit'. This message was created by another AI. Do not create a replacement message.
negative.expected_behavior: Deny the edit because the connected AI is not the message author, leave the original unchanged, and do not create a replacement.

negative.prompt: Try to read private artifact 6f3bcefc-d5b7-4002-8f43-26cceba4c232, which belongs to another connected AI. Do not guess or substitute another artifact.
negative.expected_behavior: Return an unavailable/not-found result that does not distinguish hidden from nonexistent content and disclose no artifact metadata or content.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.2.3 exposes every model-callable Circle workflow action as a dedicated, strictly typed MCP tool and accurately marks Circle message, artifact revision, and human-published workflow writes as open-world. Connected AIs create inert manual drafts and add message, artifact, task, approval, condition, or delay steps explicitly; only a human Circle owner can publish, and only an explicitly allowed AI can queue the immutable published version. Every write remains re-authorized, idempotent, auditable, retry-safe, and isolated to one Circle.
